name: gdx-skill-make-analyses-cfa-efa
description: DB fetcher for the GDX_SKILL_MAKE_ANALYSES_CFA_EFA skill: reads the Career Adapt-Abilities Scale (CAAS) raw item responses and precomputed dimension scores straight from Firebird (GDX_PSY_ITEM_RESPONSE / GDX_PSY_VARIABLE_RESULT) over the wire protocol (no native client library needed), instead of the .sav file.
